brief_rationale: All responsibility chain items are met with no serious or minor errors. The trajectory safely triages current status, contextualizes the pathology result, establishes medication boundaries, and provides a concrete follow-up plan with escalation thresholds. Three high-order points are completed: patient misconception correction about valsartan and symptom improvement, hidden state discovery of dose confusion and work constraints, and real-world constraint navigation through appointment sequencing. Two completed high-order points qualify for Grade 5.
